_note: Versioned metric contracts. Similar-looking metrics are NOT treated as equivalent until definitions match.

click_through_rate.limitations: requires both impressions and clicks on the same source rows

conversion_rate.limitations: a generic conversions column might count signups, not purchases — the source event label governs meaning

purchase_conversion_rate.limitations: only defined where a clearly labeled purchase column exists

return_on_ad_spend.limitations: undefined when spend is zero or missing; never report as zero
